title: School Absence Recovery Task Backlog
dataSources: Nanit sleep sessions (`nanit:sleep`), Hatch routines (`hatch:routine`), school calendar events (`schoolcalendar:event`), allowance transactions (`allowance:txn`), and kid screen usage (`screentime:usage`).
app: Family-routine telemetry from Nanit sleep exports, Hatch routine data, school calendars, allowance and chore apps, and Apple Screen Time sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=schoolcalendar:event
| search event_type="absence_recovery"
| stats sum(recovery_tasks_open) as open_tasks max(days_since_absence) as max_days_since_absence by child_name
| sort 0 - open_tasks
description: Ranks childrens by make-up task backlog.
value: Absence recovery work compounds fast, so a ranked backlog helps you focus on the child who needs the most support first.
implementation: Send make-up task backlog events to `index=personal` and keep `child_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of make-up task backlog by children.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges which childrens stand out most for make-up task backlog.
